behavior_changes: Middleware order is request correlation -> CORS -> protection -> routes. Early 400/413 refusals carry CORS headers for allowed origins; CORS preflight responses are produced before the protection layer and no longer carry its X-Frame-Options/Cache-Control headers.
http.request may carry code HTTP_REQUEST_FAILED (exception) or HTTP_REQUEST_CANCELLED (cancellation; no status when no response started).
Worker emits job.lease_expired (job_id only) after committing an expired-lease requeue; the expired claim time is not available from UPDATE RETURNING and is not invented.
Worker no longer prints a per-job failure line; failures appear as job.finished status failed with a fixed code after commit.
